column1: # mapping_set_description: Public-benefit statuses of a country placed under the generic public-benefit statuses of the membership codelists, and linked to the national non-profit types of schema.org where the names correspond. schema.org gives no definition of its members on the type pages, so those two links are matched on the names and on the Italian Third Sector Code, from which schema.org says most Italian categories are drawn.

column8: Entry in the national register (RUNTS) brings public-benefit duties and tax and other benefits; it is not itself a recognition of public utility.
